extracted.intended_audience: manufacturers/suppliers and contracting officers responding to or administering bids for medical supplies for the U.S. Indian service (advertisement May 10, 1880)
extracted.subtask_description: Recording and evaluating proposals and awarding contracts for medical supplies for the Indian service (New York City advertisement, May 10, 1880). Covers item specifications, unit sizes, quantities, delivery points, pricing, and award basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Figures in large type denote awarded rates
rubrics_metrics.description: [Note.—Figures in large type denote the rates at which contracts have been awarded.]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The abstract explicitly marks the contract award price/rate by printing it in large type. Readers and bidders should read large-type figures as the awarded contract rates for the corresponding item/units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards made on comparison of samples
rubrics_metrics.description: awards were made on comparison of samples with which each bid was accompanied.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bidders were required to submit samples with their proposals; contract decisions considered direct comparison of those samples (quality) in addition to price. Quality/sample conformity is therefore an explicit element of evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Points of delivery must be specified
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each line-item shows required points of delivery. Bidders must indicate and be prepared to deliver to the stated delivery locations; delivery location is a requirement in the proposal and affects award and pricing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specified packaging and unit sizes
rubrics_metrics.description: Item entries include packaging and unit-size descriptors (e.g., 'in 4-oz. bottles', 'in 32-oz. bottles', 'in 10-pound tins', 'in 1-pound pots', 'in 5-pound tins').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supplies must be offered in the exact containers and unit sizes listed. Bids not matching the specified package sizes or containers would be nonconforming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material and quality descriptors
rubrics_metrics.description: Items are qualified by material/quality descriptors (examples: 'purified', 'crystallized', 'for disinfection', 'aromatic', 'commercial', 'washed', 'white', 'assorted sizes', 'solid steel').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Products must meet the descriptive quality standards stated in the item line. These descriptors form part of the specification used to judge sample conformity and acceptability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unit pricing and measurement units
rubrics_metrics.description: Prices and bids are expressed per unit/weight/number (e.g., per ounce, per pound, per bottle, per dozen, per number).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bids must state rates in the unit formats required on the abstract (oz., lb., bottle, dozen, number). Evaluation and award use those unit rates directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantities required specified per item
rubrics_metrics.description: Each item line shows the quantity required (numerical columns for required counts, weights, or volumes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bidders must price and be able to supply the quantities listed; the quantity column is an explicit requirement for contract performance and for evaluating total cost proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed instrument/dressing specifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Instruments and dressings are listed with sizes, counts, materials, and form (examples: 'Muslin, unbleached, unsized, 1 yard wide', 'Scissors, large and small', 'Thermometer, clinical', 'Syringes, hypodermic').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suppliers must furnish instruments and dressings that conform to the enumerated dimensions, materials, and types; these itemized technical specs are part of the procurement standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Miscellaneous and additional articles listed as separate requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections labeled 'MISCELLANEOUS' and 'ADDITIONAL ARTICLES' enumerate numerous ancillary items (basins, funnels, corkscrews, pill-boxes, vials, specific tinctures, etc.) with quantities and unit specifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The procurement covers a wide range of specific ancillary items; bidders should address each listed miscellaneous/additional article per the stated unit, quantity, and packaging requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annotation and footnote qualifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Footnotes and letter annotations qualify certain items (examples in text: 'a Solid steel.', '6 Coe's machines.', 'c Per pound.', '* Bids also received from Mansell, Birnbann & Co. ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annotations modify specifications (material, unit basis, make/model) or record vendor/award notes. Bidders and contracting officers must observe these qualifiers when interpreting requirements or award records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of standardized measures and apothecary units
rubrics_metrics.description: Weights and measures used include apothecary and common measures (ounces, pounds, pints, quarts, yards, 'g. s. bottles' and other government-standard containers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All pricing, packaging, and sample submissions are expected to conform to the specified standardized measurement units; conversion or ambiguity could render a bid nonresponsive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance of specific makes/models where named
rubrics_metrics.description: Some items reference specific makes/models (example: 'Coe's machines').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a particular maker or model is named, the listed make/model is acceptable or required; bidders offering alternatives should provide clear samples and justification for equivalence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Descriptive labeling of medicines and preparations
rubrics_metrics.description: Medicinal items are described precisely (e.g., 'Chloroform, purified', 'Alcohol, in 32-oz. bottles', 'Mercury, corrosive chloride (corrosive sublimate)', 'Opium, camphorated tincture', 'Quinia, sulphate of, in 1-oz. bottles').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pharmaceutical preparations must match the exact formulation/description and container specifications; sample testing or comparison is implied as part of acceptance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Itemized recording of proposals received and awarding transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: Abstract lists proposals received (quantities offered, bid rates) and separately records 'contracts awarded' (awarded rates indicated).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procurement transparency is achieved by documenting all proposals and showing awarded rates; bidders can be evaluated against the recorded proposals and awarded rates for fairness and audit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specification of assortments and variable sizes
rubrics_metrics.description: Several items accept or require 'assorted sizes' (e.g., 'Cupping-glasses, assorted sizes', 'Sponge,* assorted').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When 'assorted sizes' is specified, bidders must supply the assortment as commonly accepted or as indicated by sample; sample submission should reflect the assortment for evaluation.
